sample_unit: expert ratings per domain per chatbot (12 responses x 8 experts)

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of chatbot answers to patient questions on 177Lu-PSMA-617 therapy
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 more accurate than Bard (2.95 vs 2.73, p=0.027); responses rated incorrect or partially correct 16.6% for ChatGPT-4 and 29.1% for Bard.
links.quote: Experts categorized the AI-generated responses as incorrect or partially correct at a rate of 16.6% for ChatGPT-4 and 29.1% for Bard.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, accuracy, readability, and safety risks of ChatGPT-4 and Google Bard when answering patient questions about prostate cancer therapy, rated by clinical experts.
